channel.title: Al-Jazeera Media Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Al-Jazeera Media Network (aljazeera.com)

item.title: How Israel-US war on Iran puts $50bn in Indian remittances at risk
item.description: The US-Israel war on Iran has caused gas shortages, while nine million Indian expats in the Gulf face uncertainty.

item.title: Iran war: What is happening on day 14 of US-Israel attacks?
item.description: Israel strikes Tehran as Iran retaliates across the Gulf; Hormuz disruption pushes oil prices higher and tensions rise.

item.title: Force majeure: What is it and why have some Gulf countries invoked it?
item.description: Several Gulf nations have declared force majeure on oil and gas shipment since the US-Israel’s war on Iran was launched.

item.title: Alcaraz sets up Medvedev Indian Wells semifinal, Sabalenka also advances
item.description: Carlos Alcaraz will meet Daniil Medvedev in the Indian Wells semifinals, while Jannik Sinner faces Alexander Zverev.

item.title: Poor in an oil-rich country: Republic of Congo’s youth hope for change
item.description: In an oil-producing country where 60 percent of people are under 25, nearly half the population lives in poverty.

item.title: Israel attacks Beirut in ‘targeted killing’ attempt, kills several in south
item.description: Israel's attacks in Lebanon are striking areas in Beirut not hit in this conflict, nor during the 2024 war.

item.title: French soldier killed and others wounded in attack in Iraq
item.description: A drone attack on a joint French-Kurdish base in northern Iraq has killed one French soldier and wounded several others.

item.title: US lawmakers introduce Justice for Hind Rajab Act
item.description: US lawmakers introduce Justice for Hind Rajab Act

item.title: Two killed in Oman by drones, several also fired at Saudi Arabia
item.description: Two drones target Oman's Sohar province, killing two foreign nationals and injuring others, state news agency reports.

item.title: China coach tells players to stay ‘calm’ in Taiwan clash at Asian Cup
item.description: China face Taiwan in a highly charged quarterfinal at the Women's Asian Cup, which already has a political focus.
